name: vibeschool-student-parent-os
description: Protect learner identity, enrollment, progress, assessment, evidence and parent linkage across VibeSchool Student and Parent OS.
---
# Student and Parent OS
Use canonical student identity and enrollment contracts. Verify learner activation, class/school binding, assessment/work ownership, progress/evidence lineage, parent linkage and released/reportable data. Enforce own-learner/cross-school boundaries and parent visibility without granting teacher/admin authority. Teacher-entered progress must connect deterministically to the intended learner and lesson; parent-facing state must come from governed released/canonical evidence, not duplicated browser state.
